images.prompt: Use case: game-texture. Create an ORIGINAL Minecraft Mekanism-style an electric Source generator texture atlas for an Ars Nouveau addon. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE for coarse pixels and charcoal casing, NOT an edit target. Exact equal 2x2 grid, no margins or labels: top-left idle front, top-right top, bottom-left side/back/bottom, bottom-right active front. Each quadrant must have the simplicity of exactly 16x16 large solid-color pixel cells, forming a 32x32 logical pixel atlas. At least 85% charcoal and neutral gray, coarse industrial bevels, recessed mechanical work area. Front feature: a recessed vertical coil with a small purple core and two gray electrical contacts. Ars purple (#9556bf) only on functional Source parts and small status lights. Idle and active front geometry MUST be identical; only purple status pixels brighten to lavender in the active front. Full square opaque faces to every edge. Flat orthographic atlas, no perspective, no text, no bloom, no gradients, no noise, no tiny details, no gold, no green, no ornate runes.
